notes: The page defines P^m(X) as the kernel of the displayed composite through the blow-up, Y, and H^0 of the m-th direct image. This is a reading of the claim, not a proof.
The next display gives the map called de Griffiths into H^1(S,R^{m-1}f_*(Q_chi)); the parenthesis says S could be replaced by P^1_k.

The triangle has i:Y→X_S, f:Y→S, g:X_S→S. The i* display and the assertion that the inverse image of Im i* is reduced to zero have been transcribed symbol by symbol; no map or injectivity theorem was proved.

The author’s own explanation is Ceci se fait par des calculs explicites essentiellement triviaux, compte tenu de la structure cohomologique connue d’une variété éclatée. No calculation is supplied here or imported.

Section 5 inserts m=2n and assumes the conditions a) and b) of 2) for the generic hyperplane immersion. It states that a cycle whose restriction is algebraically equivalent to zero is cohomologically equivalent to zero modulo torsion.

The following quotient is called groupe de Griffiths, tensorisé par Q, and is said to contain P^{2n}_{alg}(X). This asserted containment and any representative-independence issues have not been checked mathematically.
The masculine source équivalent and the incomplete final phrase - vectoriel qui a are retained without supplying a feminine ending or a missing noun.
Reading the displayed 0, 1, m-1, 2n and all arrows found no need to replace an ink reading to make a formula parse. No mathematical proof-check event is claimed.

The first generic-point cell has no detached bar, whereas later Y and k(s) cells visibly do. The structural overlap is recorded without using the expected algebraic-geometric parameter to select a chronology.

H global conventions for machine ell and authorial emphasis are fully credited. Bold versus plain underlined coefficient letters and absent handwriting wrappers alone are not scored as H reading errors.
No other reader files, other page images, OCR, web source, published text, or LaTeX compilation was used. The only structural validation is brace/environment/JSON checking.
H’s double-hyphen LaTeX dash encoding at the final phrase is treated as ordinary dash typography rather than a separate ink error; the single source dash is retained.
